newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAFRICA RESERVES DATA MAY BE RELEASED FRI - OFFICIAL. [CORRECTED 12:15 GMT]
newsitem.headline: SAFRICA RESERVES DATA MAY BE RELEASED FRI - OFFICIAL. [CORRECTED 12:15 GMT]

text.p: The Reserve Bank said on Friday that September gold and foreign exchange reserves data could be released later in the day.
An official said the data, normally released on the fifth working day of the month, was currently being reviewed by Reserve Bank Governor Chris Stals.
"It is possible that the figures will be released at (1600 GMT) this afternoon," the official said.
He said the central bank would only be able to confirm whether the data would be released on the day at 1300 GMT.
The data was originally scheduled for release on Monday October 7 (corrects from October 4).
